### Flappy Bird Game Overview

**Play instructions:**
 1. Unzip
 2. Launch exe

**Controls:**
- Space to start game

- Space/Left Click to flap the bird

- R to reset of game over

- Esc to exit

**Objective:**
- Keep the bird off the floor

- Don’t crash into pipes

- Gain score with each pipe gap passed through
